tagline: Weather application with geolocation, API integration, and secure serverless data handling.

details.overview: WeatherScope is a weather application that provides real-time weather information using the OpenWeatherMap API. The project includes geolocation-based weather detection, city search, persistent search history, and secure API handling through serverless functions.
engineering_challenges: Securing API keys using serverless backend functions
Integrating geolocation services for location-based weather data
Managing asynchronous API requests and error handling
Persisting user search history across sessions
key_features: City search with persistent search history
Secure API requests through serverless functions
Dynamic UI updates based on live weather conditions
what_i_learned: Working with REST APIs and real-time data fetching
Handling asynchronous operations and API responses
Securing frontend applications with serverless functions
